bagPolicy.summary: Small clutches and fanny packs up to 6 by 9 inches may be non-clear and have no more than one pocket. Larger bags must be clear and smaller than 12 by 6 by 12 inches; qualifying empty hydration packs are allowed.
allowed: One-pocket clutch or fanny pack up to 6 by 9 inches
Clear bag smaller than 12 by 6 by 12 inches
Empty hydration pack with limited compartments
prohibited: Non-clear bags larger than 6 by 9 inches
Clear bags at or above 12 by 6 by 12 inches
Clutches and fanny packs with multiple pockets
bagPolicy.note: All bags are searched before entry. The festival recommends leaving bags at home and notes that the policy is subject to change.

parking.note: The festival is in Piedmont Park. No general on-site parking program is published; use public transportation or the current festival travel guidance. ADA parking and entry instructions are published separately for credentialed guests.

rideshare.note: Request rideshare service to Piedmont Park and follow in-app directions. After the festival, exit the park and use the nearest pickup point shown by the app.

concessions.note: Food trucks serve local and regional options, including Southern barbecue and vegetarian-friendly choices. Consult the current festival map for vendor locations.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Shaky Knees publishes dedicated guidance for ADA parking and entry, accessible entrances, viewing areas, restrooms, mobility devices, ASL, hearing accommodations, service animals, and medical dietary needs. Review the accessibility center before arrival.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Guests may leave and re-enter until 7:00 p.m. local time. Wristbands are scanned on exit, and all returning guests must pass through security again.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The box office is beside the Piedmont Park Community Center at 12th Street and Piedmont Avenue. It handles will call, wristband assistance, upgrades, and eligible exchange-ticket support; government-issued ID is required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Shaky Knees Music Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
